tweet.text:
Where the forest breathes in silence and the earth glows back 🌲

A hidden trail illuminated by bioluminescent mushrooms transforms the night into something almost otherworldly. Nestled deep within the ancient woods of Olympic National Park, this surreal scene feels like stepping into a living fairytale.   

The soft neon-blue glow contrasts beautifully against the dark moss-covered ground, creating a magical pathway that seems guided by nature itself.
